name: Cannibal Corpse
description:
'''Cannibal Corpse''' is an American [[death metal]] band formed in [[Buffalo, New York]], in 1988, now based in [[Tampa, Florida]]. They have been on [[Metal Blade Records]] for the entirety of their studio recording career. The band has released sixteen studio albums, two box sets, four video albums, and two live albums. The band has had little radio or television exposure throughout its existence, although a [[cult following]] began to build with the releases of their early albums, including ''[[Butchered at Birth]]'' (1991) and ''[[Tomb of the Mutilated]]'' (1992). As of 2015, they achieved worldwide sales of two million units for combined sales of all their albums.

The band initially performed a primitive form of [[Thrash metal|thrash]]-influenced death metal on their demo and debut album ''[[Eaten Back to Life]]'' before evolving to an explicit death metal style on their sophomore effort ''Butchered at Birth''. While many other bands of their era focused on [[Blasphemy|blasphemous]] and [[Satanism|Satanic]] themes, Cannibal Corpse has employed a focus on [[graphic violence]] themes inspired by [[Horror film|horror films]] throughout its career. The lyrics written by original vocalist [[Chris Barnes (musician)|Chris Barnes]] drew further influence from [[true crime]], and explored extreme and [[taboo]] subjects such as [[sexual violence]], [[misogyny]] and [[child murder]]. The lyrical content on albums released following Barne's 1995 dismissal are considered to be less extreme in nature. Barne's vocals on the early albums are considered to be mostly incomprehensible grunts sang through [[Groove (music)|groove]]-oriented [[Cadence|cadences]], while the vocal performances of his successor [[George "Corpsegrinder" Fisher]] have been noted by critics for their rapid-fire delivery and relative clarity in [[enunciation]]. As their career progressed, Cannibal Corpse also placed greater emphasis on [[Hook (music)|hooks]] and technically proficient [[Instrumentation (music)|instrumentation]] in comparison to the raw and [[Song structure|unstructured]] nature of their early recordings. While the band has deliberately maintained the same general style throughout its career to avoid alienating its fans and the [[metal community]], its members have been involved with various side projects performing other styles of metal.  

The band has seen several lineup changes throughout its run, with bassist [[Alex Webster]] and drummer [[Paul Mazurkiewicz]] being the only constant members. The band's current lineup includes Mazurkiewicz, Webster, vocalist [[George Fisher (musician)|George Fisher]], and guitarists [[Rob Barrett]] and [[Erik Rutan]]. Cannibal Corpse has been credited as being among the most prominent and influential death metal bands of all time by most publications. The band's music is highly controversial, and the extreme nature of the band's lyrics and album covers has resulted in bans in several countries.
